note: Vermont's largest state-park campground, on the south-east shore of Lake Carmi in two areas: Area A by the lake's east shore, and Area B on a knoll reached by a road across the park's black spruce-tamarack bog (a State Natural Area). Prime sites along the shore in both areas look at the lake through a belt of trees; each area has a swimming beach. Many interior sites list only 15-20 ft, so site choice matters for a 23-ft rig. Registered campers get a PIN for the security gate. --Claude
